If he's transferred his flag to the Interdictor&hellip;he has more nerve, better timing than my man. My captain will flinch first.|General Melvar and Warlord Zsinj|<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>}}
A male served as a [[Captain/Legends|'''captain''']] in the forces of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. He commanded the ''Serpent's Smile'', an old [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]], at the [[Battle of Vahaba]], where Zsinj directed him to advance upon the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418]] [[Interdictor/Legends|interdictor]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Stellar Web]]'' and either destroy the interdictor or force it off course so that Zsinj could escape aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']]. The captain did as ordered, maneuvering ''Serpent's Smile'' between two [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], ''[[Crynyd]]'' and [[Skyhook (Star Destroyer)|''Skyhook'']], and attacking the interdictor. The captain held on course for the interdictor with the intention of forcing the enemy [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to "flinch" and turn away from a collision. As the two [[Warship/Legends|warships]] neared one another and neither vessel showed any signs of diverting course, a concentrated barrage from ''Stellar Web'' brought down the ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer's shields, destroying the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. Zsinj subsequently ordered the crew to lock down the warship's current bearing and abandon ship, hoping that ''Serpent's Smile''{{'s}} flaming hulk would impact with ''Stellar Web''.
